en.description:
Board all passengers onto the Ferris Wheel! A strategic circular puzzle that now features three escalating stages of difficulty.

【How to Play】
-  Rotate (Tap): 
 ・Gate at Top: The Ferris Wheel moves one step forward.
 ・Gate at Bottom: The passenger line moves one step forward.
-  Boarding (Drag): Drag the gate up or down to move a passenger onto the wheel.
-  Goal: Clear all 3 Stages to complete the mission!
【Stage Rules】
-  Stage 1: Simple boarding with no exits.
-  Stage 2: Passengers exit when they reach the gate (if there is space in line).
-  Stage 3: The ultimate challenge! Passengers exit into empty spaces, or the line moves forward to make room.

Take control of the wheel and master all stages!
en.releaseNotes: New 3-Stage System! The game now features three distinct levels of difficulty. Master the boarding flow from the simple Stage 1 to the strategic Stage 3 to achieve a complete win!
